name: Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 12 (SCA12)

sections.overview:
Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 12 (SCA12) – Causes, Symptoms, Treatment Herbal Remedies 
 Abstract 

Neurodegenerative disorders affecting coordination and motor control often present diagnostic and therapeutic challenges due to their progressive and inherited nature. Spinocerebellar Ataxia (SCA) is a collective term used for a group of inherited neurodegenerative disorders that primarily affect the cerebellum and its connected neural pathways. The cerebellum is the part of the brain responsible for coordination, balance, precision of movement and fine motor control. In SCA, gradual degeneration of cerebellar neurons leads to progressive dysfunction of these systems over time. The condition is considered progressive that means it worsens gradually over years. So let’s see it in detail and how to manage it.
sections.introduction: There are over 35 types of spinocerebellar ataxia and one of its types is spinocerebellar ataxia type 12 (SCA12) is a rare, autosomal dominant disorder and progressive neurodegenerative disorder that primarily affects movement and coordination. It stands out among spinocerebellar ataxias due to its early hallmark of action tremor rather than gait instability. The disease is marked by a slowly progressive course and is often dominated by action tremor, particularly of the hands, which may precede gait imbalance by several years. Because of this atypical onset, SCA-12 is frequently misdiagnosed as essential tremor or Parkinsonian tremor in its early stages. It commonly develops in the 30 – 50 years of age.
sections.causes: It is a genetic disorder inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern and is caused by a CAG trinucleotide repeat expansion in the PPP2R2B gene, located on chromosome 5. This gene plays a regulatory role in neuronal signaling pathways by encoding a subunit of protein phosphatase 2A, an enzyme essential for maintaining neuronal stability and function and expansion beyond the normal range disrupts normal gene regulation leading to altered neuronal communication.
sections.symptoms:
Early Changes Include 

 Action tremor of hands (most characteristic feature) 
 Tremor during writing, eating, or fine motor tasks 
 Mild imbalance or unsteadiness 
 Subtle changes in handwriting 

 Progressive Changes Include 

 Gait ataxia (difficulty walking on uneven surfaces) 
 Limb incoordination 
 Slurred or scanning speech (dysarthria) 
 Intention tremor 
 Difficulty with precise hand movements
sections.signs:
Postural and kinetic tremor of the upper limbs. 
 Incoordination on finger to nose and heel to shin testing. 
 Broad based, cautious gait. 
 Difficulty performing rapid alternating movements.
sections.diagnosis:
The diagnosis of SCA-12 requires a combination of clinical evaluation, family history, neuroimaging and genetic testing. 
 Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) may show cerebellar atrophy but can be normal in early stages. 
 Genetic testing for PPP2R2B CAG repeats via PCR or Southern blot.
sections.treatment:
Treatment is primarily symptomatic and supportive that focuses on reducing symptom severity, maintaining function and improving quality of life like:


 Physiotherapy to improve balance and coordination 
 Occupational therapy for adaptive techniques and assistive devices 
 Speech therapy for dysarthria and communication support 
 Beta-blockers (e.g. propranolol, primidone) for action tremor 
 Antidepressants for mood disorders 
 Medications for anxiety when required
sections.ayurvedic_overview:
In Ayurveda naming of each disease is not possible as there are unlimited diseases and we can correlate it on the basis of dosha, dhatu (tissue) involvement. So in this disease it can be seen that there is dominance of vata dosha along with Beej Dushti (gene defects) and that also involves further depletion of dhatu (tissues), especially majja dhatu (bone marrow and nervous system) that is present in the central nervous system. As the age increases vata dominates the body and along with beej dushti (gene defects) it manifests in the 30s and 50s of age and since this is due to beej dushti (gene defects) and as per ayurveda these conditions have no cure but can be very manageable with various herbs and procedure. The treatment protocol is mainly vata shamak (vata pacifying), brihaniya (nourishing) and rasayana (rejuvenation).

 Herbs That Can Be Used 

 Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri) enhances cognition and coordination via antioxidant effects on brain cells, easing dysarthria and cognitive decline in SCA-12. 
 Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) strengthens nerves and muscles as a Balya Rasayana (strengthening and rejuvenating), countering ataxia progression with its withanolides that protect against oxidative damage. 
 Kapikachhu (Mucuna pruriens) supplies natural L-DOPA for motor control mimicking benefits in parkinsonism-like SCA12 features. 
 Jatamansi (Nardostachys jatamansi) calms Vata thus is helpful in tremors and stabilizes mood. 
 Vacha (Acorus calamus) improves speech clarity and nerve conduction. 
 Bala (Sida cordifolia) improves strength of nerves and muscles useful in gait instability. 

 Panchkarma Procedures 

 Shastika Shali Pinda Sweda (rice bolus massage) applies warm herbal rice poultices to bolster muscles and coordination which helps in gait issues. 
 Basti (Medicated Enema) is considered the primary treatment for vata disorders. Anuvasana (oil based) and Niruha (decoction based) basti help regulate vata dosha, support nervous tissue, improve gait, reduce tremors and strengthen muscles. 
 Abhyanga (Oil Massage) full body massage with Vata pacifying medicated oils (e.g., Bala Taila, Ksheerabala Taila) improves circulation, calms neuromuscular excitability and reduces tremors and stiffness. 
 Shirodhara (Continuous pouring of medicated oil on the forehead) stabilizes Vata dosha, improves mental clarity, reduces tremors and supports speech and coordination. 
 Marsha Nasya (nasal oil drops) targets brain channels, enhancing speech, cognition and mood stability in SCA-12. 
 Sarvanga Parisheka (medicated oil pouring) using Dashamoola Kwath helps in easing hyperreflexia and promoting relaxation.
